families.gist: the shared CST store, one door for cc and cw
families.name: handoff

families.gist: a spawn brief checked against the repo it names
families.name: brief

families.example: x probe bare 'is it us or cc?'
families.gist: claude sessions our setup cannot touch
families.name: probe

families.gist: which verbs are used, by whom, how fast, how they fail
families.name: stats

families.gist: trace lines for commands x did not run
families.name: trace

args.description: paths that go into the commit, read from the tree root, after --
args.name: paths

hold-unstaged.description: hold the unstaged and untracked files outside the named paths aside while the hooks run, then put them back byte for byte

repo.description: commit in that repo instead, only on its main and never mid-merge; paths are relative to its root

verbs.name: lane commit
verbs.purpose: commit only the named paths, print the new sha; mid-merge concludes it; --repo <path> commits on that repo's main

verbs.name: lane push
verbs.purpose: push HEAD's sha to its branch and read the remote back; a frame worktree pushes from the main checkout

verbs.name: lane pr-open
verbs.purpose: open a pr from the pushed branch onto main as the x-coder-cc app

verbs.name: lane merge-main
verbs.purpose: fetch and merge origin/main into this branch; a conflict prints the files and stops

verbs.name: lane unlock
verbs.purpose: decrypt the git-crypt files of a worktree that holds ciphertext, so staging stops dying

for.description: the reading agent, one of any, ccli, cclio, cw; files addressed to another agent are left alone

verbs.name: handoff list
verbs.purpose: list the pending CSTs in the shared handoff store, newest first, without reading or deleting one

args.description: a word of the handoff filename; omitted with several pending, a terminal shows a picker
args.name: slug

verbs.name: handoff peek
verbs.purpose: print one pending CST's META block as markdown; the file stays untouched

args.description: a word of the handoff filename; omitted with several pending, a terminal shows a picker
args.name: slug

for.description: the reading agent, one of any, ccli, cclio, cw; files addressed to another agent are left alone

verbs.name: handoff ingest
verbs.purpose: print one pending CST in full and delete its file, unless it is shared

audience.description: the agent the CST is for, one of any, ccli, cclio, cw; any (the default) is whoever pulls next

author.description: the agent that wrote it, named in the file as by-<author>; any by default

lane.description: the work lane the thread ran in: pm, code, research, design; any by default

replaces.description: a pending handoff of the same thread, by slug: it is removed as this one lands, and its -shared carries over

shared.description: keep the file on ingest, for several pullers

slug.description: the topic, kebab-cased into the file name

verbs.name: handoff write
verbs.purpose: save the CST on stdin to the shared store as one file; --replaces removes the sibling it supersedes

args.description: a word of the handoff filename; must match exactly one
args.name: slug

all.description: delete every pending CST instead of one

verbs.name: handoff delete
verbs.purpose: remove one pending CST by slug, or every one with --all; shared files go too, to the macos trash

repo.description: the repo the brief targets; defaults to the repo of the cwd

verbs.name: brief check
verbs.purpose: check that every backticked path, script, verb and id in a brief exists, and lint its exit lines; a pass stamps it

verbs.name: probe bare
verbs.purpose: ask a claude -p session with no CLAUDE.md, rules, plugins, hooks or MCP, from a temp dir; prints the answer and its cost

args.description: the probe name; its scratch dir and session id live under ~/.local/state/x/probes/<name>
args.name: name

args.description: a settings json file, or inline json, for --settings
args.name: settings

verbs.name: probe session
verbs.purpose: run a named claude -p probe with a settings json from a scratch dir; the same name again resumes that session

verbs.name: knowledge list
verbs.purpose: list the fleet reference shelf docs/knowledge: each file with its purpose and its verified-on stamp

args.description: a word of the file name; completion offers them
args.name: name

verbs.name: knowledge read
verbs.purpose: print one docs/knowledge file and log the read, so the shelf learns which files earn their place

args.description: a verb or a family, e.g. `lane` or `lane push`
args.name: verb

level.description: short: names and purposes only; full (the default): the whole schema

verbs.name: schema
verbs.purpose: print the json schema of a verb or a family — the same entry that dispatches it

verbs.name: completion
verbs.purpose: print a shell completion script generated from the registry, for `source <(x completion zsh)`

days.description: the window, in local days back from today (default 30)

verbs.name: stats
verbs.purpose: count x calls from the trace files: per family and verb, callers, p50/p95 time, failure kinds, unused verbs

args.description: the command line as typed; only `pnpm <script>` is kept
args.name: command

duration.description: how long the command ran, in ms

verbs.name: trace record
verbs.purpose: write the trace line for a pnpm script dima typed; only the zsh hook calls it, so help hides it
